_meta.purpose: Aspect taxonomy for English product reviews (Amazon All Beauty), used for manual aspect annotation and for keyword pre-screening of which reviews are worth annotating.
_meta.status: Proposed vocabulary. Aliases are matching hints for pre-screening and for annotators; they are NOT annotations and no accuracy has been measured. The frequency of each category over the project's reviews is measured by scripts/sequence_readiness.py.
_meta.alias_syntax: Lowercase. A trailing * matches any word continuation (irritat* matches irritation, irritated). Anything else is matched as a whole word or phrase.
_meta.companion_files: Film/YouTube-comment aspects are not repeated here: they live in ontology/aspect_taxonomy.json and ontology/wsd_lexicon_full.json (existing WSD component).

families.PERFORMANCE: How well the product does its job or what it does to the user.
families.SENSORY: What the user perceives directly: smell, feel, look.
families.PHYSICAL: The product as an object: packaging, size, durability.
families.SERVICE: Everything around the product: delivery, seller, authenticity.
families.GENERAL: The product as a whole, with no specific facet.

categories.definition: Whether the product achieves its purpose: results, moisturising, cleaning, volume, hold, shine.
Effect on the body that is a reaction or safety issue: irritation, allergy, rash, breakout, burning, ingredients and chemicals.
How the product feels or behaves in the hand and on the body: consistency, greasiness, lather.
Colour, shade, finish or visual look of the product or of the result.
Container, packaging and closures: bottle, pump, cap, jar, tube, leaks, seals.
How much product there is or how big the item is.
How long the product or its effect lasts, and whether it breaks or deteriorates.
How easy the product is to apply, handle or use, including applicators and tools.
Price, cost and whether the product is worth it.
Whether the item is genuine, new and as described.
Shipping, delivery, seller behaviour, returns and refunds.
Opinion about the product as a whole with no specific facet (love it, waste of money, would buy again). Not a missing aspect: the target is the product itself.

other.definition: A clear facet that no category above covers. Annotators write the facet in the notes column; frequent cases are promoted to new categories.
